title: Stochastic Voronoi Ensembles for Anomaly Detection
Stochastic Voronoi Ensembles for Anomaly Detection
summary: Anomaly detection methods struggle with data exhibiting varying local densities, where distance-based methods miss local anomalies and density-based methods require careful parameter selection and incur quadratic time complexity. SVEAD constructs an ensemble of random Voronoi diagrams by sampling anchors, scores points by normalized cell-relative distance weighted by local scale, and averages scores across partitions. Across 45 ADBench datasets it achieves the highest average AUC-ROC (0.8538) and AUC-PR (0.5000) among 12 baselines, including 0.9339 AUC-ROC on cardio, while maintaining linear time and constant space complexity.

approach: Route is paper_only with no author repository on disk (only an uncloned anonymous.4open.science link), so SVEAD is reimplemented from the paper: for each of t=100 partitions, sample m anchors uniformly without replacement, assign every point to its nearest anchor in standardized feature space (implicit Voronoi, no cell boundaries), score each point as (delta/delta_max) * delta_mean inside its cell, skip singleton cells, and average the per-partition scores. The match target is C1: AUC-ROC 0.9339 on ADBench cardio (1831 samples, 21 features, 176 anomalies); the dataset is fetched at runtime through a validated fallback chain (ADBench GitHub raw -> OpenML cardiotocography -> UCI Cardiotocography), all of which reduce to exactly the same 1831x21 table with 176 positives, and a hard validation gate asserts that shape before any scoring. The m hyperparameter is grid-searched over {2,4,...,256} with 5 seeded repeats per value and t=100, matching the paper's protocol (R7, R8); we report both the label-tuned best m and the full m-curve so the +/-0.0189 tolerance band is interpretable, plus AUC-PR (C2) for free from the same runs. C3/C4 (45 datasets) and C5/C6 (GPU 500k-instance scalability) are explicitly out of scope on this CPU-only machine and are flagged as 'not reproduced' in the output.
steps: Install/verify deps: `pip install numpy scipy pandas scikit-learn matplotlib requests tqdm openpyxl xlrd`; confirm sklearn.datasets.fetch_openml and sklearn.metrics imports succeed.

Write svead/data.py with a priority loader and an on-disk cache at data/cardio.npz: (1) local cache; (2) ADBench GitHub — GET https://api.github.com/repos/Minqi824/ADBench/git/trees/main?recursive=1, find any path containing 'cardio' ending in .csv/.npz/.arff, download via raw.githubusercontent.com; (3) sklearn.datasets.fetch_openml(data_id=1466) or name='cardiotocography' — take the 21 feature columns, keep rows with NSP in {1,3}, label = (NSP == 3); (4) UCI fallback https://archive.ics.uci.edu/static/public/193/cardiotocography.zip -> CTG.xls, same 21-feature/NSP filter.

Validate the loaded table in svead/data.py: assert X.shape == (1831, 21), y.sum() == 176, mean(y) ~= 0.0961, no NaN/inf (assumption A6); if any assertion fails on a fallback source, log the mismatch into the provenance dict and continue, because the source is then not guaranteed to be the ADBench cardio table.

Write svead/svead_core.py: sample_anchors(X, m, rng) -> unique row indices (R1); assign_cells(X, A, chunk_rows) -> (cell_ids, delta) using chunked Euclidean distance and argmin with lowest-index tie-break (R2, R11); cell_stats -> per-cell delta_max and delta_mean computed for all points before any scoring (R4); score_partition -> s = (delta / delta_max) * delta_mean with NaN for singleton cells and a delta_max == 0 guard (R3, R5); svead_score(X, m, t, seed) -> nanmean over t partitions, 0 if all NaN, plus diagnostics (cell-size histogram, skipped fraction, per-partition seconds) (R6, R12).

Write svead/metrics.py: roc_auc_score wrapper, average_precision_score (primary AUC-PR), trapezoidal precision_recall_curve AUC (secondary), and summarize(list) -> mean/std/min/max; all functions take scores first and labels second so labels are consumed only post-prediction (R9, R10).

Run the smoke test: `python experiments/smoke_test.py`. Part A: synthetic 300x6 with 10% Gaussian outliers, m=4, t=3 -> assert finite non-negative scores, shape (300,), AUC-ROC > 0.8. Part B: real cardio, m=8, t=5 -> assert score shape (1831,), deterministic repeat for the same seed, total runtime < 60 s.

Run the pre-full-run intermediate checks below (dataset signature, standardization stats, anchor uniqueness, cell-size/skip diagnostics, a kNN-distance and IsolationForest sanity baseline, single-run timing extrapolation).

Write experiments/run_cardio.py: outer loop over m in the 8-value grid, inner loop over the 5 seeds, each run calling svead_score on the standardized matrix with t=100, recording AUC-ROC, AUC-PR (both variants), wall time, skipped-point fraction and cell statistics; append rows to results/per_m_table.csv and dump raw per-run records to results/raw_cardio.json.

Launch the full suite: `python experiments/run_cardio.py`; after the first two m values finish, check that the extrapolated total stays inside the budget (expected total is only a few minutes because the per-run cost is ~0.1-3 s at these sizes) and only then let it complete.

Select best m = argmax of mean AUC-ROC across the 5 seeds; compute mean/std for AUC-ROC and AUC-PR at that m, and also record the fixed-m=128 (A3 fallback) result and the full m-curve for sensitivity.

Write reproduce.py: load data from cache, reuse or regenerate results/raw_cardio.json, run selection, then write results/metrics.json with (a) C1 value vs 0.9339 with the 0.0189 band and PASS/FAIL verdict, (b) C2 value vs 0.5356, (c) per-m table and per-repeat spreads, (d) dataset provenance and validation flags, (e) timing, (f) the assumption ledger entries applied, (g) an explicit not_reproduced block for C3, C4, C5 and C6 (45-dataset average and GPU/500k scalability are out of scope on CPU).

Run the final entrypoint `python reproduce.py` and read results/metrics.json; report the reproduced C1 with its spread, label the overall verdict partially_reproduced, and never present C3-C6 as reproduced.
smoke_test: `python experiments/smoke_test.py` — synthesizes 300x6 data with 10% outliers at m=4, t=3 and asserts finite non-negative scores, shape (300,), AUC-ROC > 0.8; then scores the full 1831x21 cardio table at m=8, t=5, asserting shape (1831,), reproducible scores for a repeated seed, and under 60 s wall clock. This exercises download -> standardize -> anchor sampling -> nearest-anchor assignment -> cell stats -> scoring -> averaging -> AUC end to end on a few seconds of compute.
intermediate_checks: Dataset signature: X.shape == (1831, 21), y.sum() == 176, anomaly rate 0.0961, zero NaN/inf, and the 21 UCI/ADBench feature names present — abort or flag loudly if a fallback source yields different counts (e.g. 2126 rows means the suspect class was not filtered).
Standardization: after StandardScaler, per-column mean ~ 0 (|mean| < 1e-9) and std ~ 1 for all 21 columns; confirm the scaler is fit with no label access.
Anchor sampling: for every m in the grid and every seed, sampled anchor indices are distinct and len == m (requirement R1), verified on 20 random (m, seed) pairs.

Cell diagnostics: for m=256 on n=1831, singleton cells must be essentially zero and skipped-point fraction < 0.5%; log non-empty cell count, max/mean cell size, and skipped fraction for every (m, seed).

Score sanity: all scores finite and >= 0; distribution roughly right-skewed with a handful of large scores matching injected/synthetic outliers; Spearman correlation with a trivial 1-NN mean-distance baseline is clearly positive.

Sanity baselines on cardio: sklearn IsolationForest(n_estimators=100, random_state=1) and a global kNN mean-distance score; both should land roughly in 0.65-0.85 AUC-ROC — if SVEAD cannot beat them, the reimplementation is wrong, not the paper.
No-cell-means-0 check: with the chosen cell_stats_scope (anchor included at distance 0), delta_mean must still be > 0 for every non-singleton cell; assert this before the full run.

Timing probe: time one full run at m=256, t=100 -> extrapolate the whole 40-run grid; if the extrapolation exceeds ~25 minutes, drop to 3 repeats and/or m in {8,16,32,64,128} (documented as a reduced protocol).
Determinism: two back-to-back runs with identical (m, seed) produce bitwise-identical score vectors.
budget_plan: Total ~90 min on CPU. Setup and data acquisition 15 min (pip installs, the ADBench/OpenML/UCI fallback chain, cache write, dataset-signature validation). Implementation of svead/data.py, svead/svead_core.py and svead/metrics.py 20 min. Smoke test and intermediate checks 10 min (including the IsolationForest/kNN sanity baselines and the timing probe). Full cardio grid 25 min reserved though expected ~5-10 min (8 m values x 5 seeds x t=100 on a 1831x21 matrix; each run is only a few seconds, so sum over m of m makes the whole grid roughly 2x the cost of a single m=256 run per seed). Final reproduce.py + metrics.json writing and interpretation 10 min. Contingency: if a run ever exceeds the projection, first cut repeats from 5 to 3, then narrow the m grid to four values, always recording the reduced protocol in results/metrics.json. C3/C4 (45 datasets) and C5/C6 (500k-instance CPU/GPU timing) are deliberately not scheduled.

"""Core SVEAD (Stochastic Voronoi Ensemble for Anomaly Detection).

Implements Sections 4.1-4.2 and Algorithm 1 of the paper:

  1. R1  sample m anchors uniformly from X *without replacement* (per partition)
  2. R2/R11  assign every point to its nearest anchor (Euclidean); no explicit
     cell boundaries / vertices are ever constructed - membership only
  3. R4  per-cell statistics delta_max and delta_mean are computed for the whole
     cell (anchor included, its own distance is 0) *before* any point is scored
  4. R3  s(x) = (delta / delta_max) * delta_mean          (Eq. 2-3)
  5. R5  a point whose cell contains only the anchor (|C| = 1) is skipped in
     that partition
  6. R6  f(x) = mean over the t partitions                (Eq. 5)

Complexity is O(n*m*d*t) with chunked distance blocks (R12); memory is
O(chunk*m) per block plus O(n + m) per partition.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np

AGG_MEAN_SCORED = "mean_over_scored_partitions"   # divide by #partitions that scored x
AGG_SUM_OVER_T = "sum_over_t_skip_zero"           # Algorithm-1-literal: divide by t


def sample_anchors(n: int, m: int, rng: np.random.Generator) -> np.ndarray:
    """R1: m distinct row indices, drawn uniformly without replacement."""
    m = int(min(m, n))
    return rng.choice(n, size=m, replace=False)


def assign_cells(X: np.ndarray, A: np.ndarray, chunk_rows: int = 4096):
    """R2/R11: nearest-anchor assignment, chunked, Euclidean.

    Returns (cell_ids, delta) with delta = ||x - a_cell|| (float64).
    np.argmin breaks distance ties by taking the lowest anchor index (A5).
    """
    n = X.shape[0]
    m = A.shape[0]
    cell_ids = np.empty(n, dtype=np.int64)
    delta = np.empty(n, dtype=np.float64)
    a_norm = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", A, A)
    for s in range(0, n, chunk_rows):
        e = min(s + chunk_rows, n)
        blk = X[s:e]
        x_norm = np.einsum("ij,ij->i", blk, blk)
        # squared Euclidean distance via the expansion, clipped at 0 for fp noise
        d2 = x_norm[:, None] + a_norm[None, :] - 2.0 * (blk @ A.T)
        np.maximum(d2, 0.0, out=d2)
        j = np.argmin(d2, axis=1)
        cell_ids[s:e] = j
        delta[s:e] = np.sqrt(d2[np.arange(e - s), j])
    return cell_ids, delta


def cell_stats(cell_ids: np.ndarray, delta: np.ndarray, m: int):
    """R4: per-cell size, delta_max and delta_mean (anchor included at distance 0)."""
    counts = np.bincount(cell_ids, minlength=m).astype(np.float64)
    sums = np.bincount(cell_ids, weights=delta, minlength=m)
    non_empty = counts > 0
    delta_mean = np.zeros(m, dtype=np.float64)
    delta_mean[non_empty] = sums[non_empty] / counts[non_empty]

    # per-cell maximum via a stable sort + reduceat (fast for large n)
    order = np.argsort(cell_ids, kind="stable")
    sorted_cells = cell_ids[order]
    sorted_delta = delta[order]
    starts = np.concatenate(([0], np.flatnonzero(np.diff(sorted_cells)) + 1))
    seg_max = np.maximum.reduceat(sorted_delta, starts)
    seg_cell = sorted_cells[starts]
    delta_max = np.zeros(m, dtype=np.float64)
    delta_max[seg_cell] = seg_max
    return counts, delta_max, delta_mean


def score_partition(X: np.ndarray, A: np.ndarray, chunk_rows: int = 4096):
    """One partition's scores: s = (delta/delta_max) * delta_mean, NaN if |C| = 1.

    Returns (scores, cell_ids, counts, delta_max, delta_mean).
    """
    m = A.shape[0]
    cell_ids, delta = assign_cells(X, A, chunk_rows=chunk_rows)
    counts, delta_max, delta_mean = cell_stats(cell_ids, delta, m)

    scores = np.full(X.shape[0], np.nan, dtype=np.float64)
    cmax = delta_max[cell_ids]
    cmean = delta_mean[cell_ids]
    # R5: singleton cells (|Ci| = 1) are skipped -> stay NaN
    # degenerate guard: delta_max == 0 (all points coincide with the anchor) -> score 0
    ok = (counts[cell_ids] > 1) & (cmax > 0)
    scores[ok] = (delta[ok] / cmax[ok]) * cmean[ok]
    zero_guard = (counts[cell_ids] > 1) & (cmax <= 0)
    if zero_guard.any():
        scores[zero_guard] = 0.0
    return scores, cell_ids, counts, delta_max, delta_mean


def svead_score(X: np.ndarray, m: int, t: int = 100, seed: int = 1,
                chunk_rows: int = 4096, agg: str = AGG_MEAN_SCORED,
                return_diag: bool = False):
    """Full SVEAD ensemble score.

    Parameters
    ----------
    X : (n, d) float array - already standardised by the caller, no labels used.
    m : number of anchors sampled per partition (R1, grid-searched hyper-parameter).
    t : ensemble size, fixed at 100 in the paper (R7).
    seed : base RNG seed; partition k uses an independent sub-stream.

    Aggregation (R6): arithmetic mean over the partitions.  With
    ``agg=AGG_MEAN_SCORED`` the mean is taken over the partitions that actually
    scored the point (skipped singleton cells do not contribute, per Sec. 4.2);
    with ``agg=AGG_SUM_OVER_T`` the sum is divided by t exactly as written in
    Algorithm 1 line 20.  A point never scored in any partition gets 0 (A7).
    """
    X = np.ascontiguousarray(X, dtype=np.float64)
    n = X.shape[0]
    m = int(min(int(m), n))
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)

    total = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.float64)
    nscored = np.zeros(n, dtype=np.int64)
    skip_events = 0
    singleton_cells = 0
    empty_cells = 0
    cell_size_max = 0
    cell_size_mean_sum = 0.0
    n_cells_counted = 0

    for _k in range(int(t)):
        idx = sample_anchors(n, m, rng)                    # R1
        A = X[idx]
        s, cell_ids, counts, dmax, dmean = score_partition(X, A, chunk_rows=chunk_rows)
        scored = ~np.isnan(s)
        total[scored] += s[scored]
        nscored[scored] += 1
        skip_events += int((~scored).sum())
        singleton_cells += int((counts == 1).sum())
        empty_cells += int((counts == 0).sum())
        ne = counts[counts > 0]
        if ne.size:
            cell_size_max = int(max(cell_size_max, ne.max()))
            cell_size_mean_sum += float(ne.mean())
            n_cells_counted += 1

"""End-to-end smoke test for the SVEAD reimplementation.

Part A: synthetic 300x6 with 10% injected Gaussian outliers, m=4, t=3.
Part B: real ADBench cardio, m=8, t=5 (shape, determinism, wall-clock).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")))

from svead.metrics import evaluate_scores          # noqa: E402
from svead.svead_core import svead_score           # noqa: E402


def part_a() -> None:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    n, d = 300, 6
    n_out = int(0.10 * n)
    normal = rng.normal(0.0, 1.0, size=(n - n_out, d))
    outliers = rng.normal(0.0, 6.0, size=(n_out, d)) + 5.0
    X = np.vstack([normal, outliers])
    y = np.concatenate([np.zeros(n - n_out, dtype=int), np.ones(n_out, dtype=int)])
    Xs = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

    t0 = time.time()
    s, diag = svead_score(Xs, m=4, t=3, seed=1, return_diag=True)
    dt = time.time() - t0
    ev = evaluate_scores(s, y)

    assert s.shape == (n,), s.shape
    assert np.isfinite(s).all(), "non-finite scores"
    assert (s >= 0).all(), "negative scores"
    assert ev["auc_roc"] > 0.8, f"synthetic AUC-ROC too low: {ev['auc_roc']}"
    print(f"[A] synthetic n=300 d=6 m=4 t=3 -> AUC-ROC={ev['auc_roc']:.4f} "
          f"AUC-PR={ev['auc_pr']:.4f} in {dt:.3f}s  skipped={diag['skipped_fraction']:.4f}")


def part_b() -> None:
    from svead.data import load_cardio

    X, y, prov = load_cardio(verbose=False)
    assert X.shape == (1831, 21), X.shape
    assert int(y.sum()) == 176, int(y.sum())
    Xs = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

    t0 = time.time()
    s1 = svead_score(Xs, m=8, t=5, seed=7)
    s2 = svead_score(Xs, m=8, t=5, seed=7)
    dt = time.time() - t0

    assert s1.shape == (1831,), s1.shape
    assert np.isfinite(s1).all() and (s1 >= 0).all()
    assert np.array_equal(s1, s2), "not deterministic for the same seed"
    s3 = svead_score(Xs, m=8, t=5, seed=8)
    assert not np.array_equal(s1, s3), "different seeds gave identical scores"
    ev = evaluate_scores(s1, y)
    assert dt < 60, f"smoke test too slow: {dt:.1f}s"
    print(f"[B] cardio m=8 t=5 -> AUC-ROC={ev['auc_roc']:.4f} AUC-PR={ev['auc_pr']:.4f} "
          f"in {dt:.3f}s (source={prov['source']})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    part_a()
    part_b()
    print("SMOKE TEST OK")

"""Full cardio protocol: m-grid {2^1..2^8} x 5 seeds, ensemble size t=100.

Writes (paths relative to the workspace root):
  results/per_m_table.csv   one row per (m, seed)
  results/raw_cardio.json   full records incl. diagnostics
  selected_config.json      the grid-selected m (kept OUTSIDE results/ so the
                            clean re-run can read the search log)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
import os
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")))

from svead.data import load_cardio                                  # noqa: E402
from svead.metrics import evaluate_scores, summarize                # noqa: E402
from svead.svead_core import AGG_MEAN_SCORED, AGG_SUM_OVER_T, svead_score  # noqa: E402

M_GRID = [2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256]     # {2^1 .. 2^8} (R7)
SEEDS = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]                       # 5 repeats (R8, A4)
T_ENSEMBLE = 100                              # fixed ensemble size (R7)


def run_grid(outdir: str = "results", verbose: bool = True):
    X, y, prov = load_cardio(verbose=False)
    Xs = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)      # labels never touched (R10)

    rows = []
    for m in M_GRID:
        per_m = {"auc_roc": [], "auc_pr": [], "auc_pr_trap": []}
        for seed in SEEDS:
            t0 = time.time()
            s, diag = svead_score(Xs, m=m, t=T_ENSEMBLE, seed=seed, return_diag=True)
            dt = time.time() - t0
            ev = evaluate_scores(s, y)          # labels consumed only here (R10)
            s_t = svead_score(Xs, m=m, t=T_ENSEMBLE, seed=seed, agg=AGG_SUM_OVER_T)
            ev_t = evaluate_scores(s_t, y)
            per_m["auc_roc"].append(ev["auc_roc"])
            per_m["auc_pr"].append(ev["auc_pr"])
            per_m["auc_pr_trap"].append(ev["auc_pr_trapezoid"])
            rows.append({
                "m": m, "seed": seed, "t": T_ENSEMBLE,
                "auc_roc": ev["auc_roc"], "auc_pr": ev["auc_pr"],
                "auc_pr_trapezoid": ev["auc_pr_trapezoid"],
                "auc_roc_agg_sum_over_t": ev_t["auc_roc"],
                "seconds": dt,
                "skipped_fraction": diag["skipped_fraction"],
                "max_cell_size": diag["max_cell_size"],
                "mean_cell_size": diag["mean_cell_size"],
                "points_never_scored": diag["points_never_scored"],
            })
            if verbose:
                print(f"  m={m:4d} seed={seed} AUC-ROC={ev['auc_roc']:.4f} "
                      f"AUC-PR={ev['auc_pr']:.4f} ({dt:.2f}s)")
        summ_roc = summarize(per_m["auc_roc"])
        summ_pr = summarize(per_m["auc_pr"])
        if verbose:
            print(f"m={m:4d}  AUC-ROC mean={summ_roc['mean']:.4f} std={summ_roc['std']:.4f} "
                  f"max={summ_roc['max']:.4f} | AUC-PR mean={summ_pr['mean']:.4f} std={summ_pr['std']:.4f}")

    best_m = max(M_GRID, key=lambda mm: summarize(
        [r["auc_roc"] for r in rows if r["m"] == mm])["mean"])
    return rows, {"best_m_by_mean_auc_roc": best_m, "m_grid": M_GRID,
                  "seeds": SEEDS, "t": T_ENSEMBLE, "provenance": prov}


def write_outputs(rows, meta, outdir: str = "results", root: str = "."):
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    path_csv = os.path.join(outdir, "per_m_table.csv")
    with open(path_csv, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows[0].keys()))
        w.writeheader()
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow({k: (f"{v:.10g}" if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k, v in r.items()})

    per_m = {}
    for m in meta["m_grid"]:
        sel = [r for r in rows if r["m"] == m]
        per_m[str(m)] = {
            "auc_roc": summarize([r["auc_roc"] for r in sel]),
            "auc_pr": summarize([r["auc_pr"] for r in sel]),
            "auc_pr_trapezoid": summarize([r["auc_pr_trapezoid"] for r in sel]),
            "auc_roc_sum_over_t": summarize([r["auc_roc_agg_sum_over_t"] for r in sel]),
            "seconds_mean": float(np.mean([r["seconds"] for r in sel])),
            "skipped_fraction_mean": float(np.mean([r["skipped_fraction"] for r in sel])),
        }
    payload = {"meta": {k: v for k, v in meta.items() if k != "provenance"},
               "provenance": meta["provenance"], "per_m": per_m,
               "runs": rows,
               "selected_m": meta["best_m_by_mean_auc_roc"]}
    with open(os.path.join(outdir, "raw_cardio.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(payload, f, indent=1, default=str)
    with open(os.path.join(root, "selected_config.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"selected_m": meta["best_m_by_mean_auc_roc"],
                   "criterion": "argmax over m of the mean AUC-ROC across the 5 repeats",
                   "m_grid": meta["m_grid"], "seeds": meta["seeds"],
                   "t": meta["t"],
                   "per_m_mean_auc_roc": {k: v["auc_roc"]["mean"] for k, v in per_m.items()},
                   "per_m_std_auc_roc": {k: v["auc_roc"]["std"] for k, v in per_m.items()},
                   "per_m_mean_auc_pr": {k: v["auc_pr"]["mean"] for k, v in per_m.items()}},
                  f, indent=1)
    return path_csv


if __name__ == "__main__":
    t0 = time.time()
    rows, meta = run_grid()
    write_outputs(rows, meta)
    print(f"\nselected m (by mean AUC-ROC over {len(SEEDS)} repeats) = {meta['best_m_by_mean_auc_roc']}")
    print(f"total wall clock {time.time() - t0:.1f}s -> results/per_m_table.csv, selected_config.json")

"""Reproduce C1 (SVEAD AUC-ROC on ADBench cardio) from scratch.

    python reproduce.py            # full protocol: m-grid x 5 repeats, t=100 + scalability probe
    python reproduce.py --no-scalability

Everything is computed here: the dataset is loaded/validated, SVEAD is run, the
metrics are computed, and the verdict is taken against the paper values that
live in state/claim_contract.json (no paper number is typed into this code).
Writes results/metrics.json.

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import time

import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(__file__)))

from svead.data import load_cardio                                       # noqa: E402
from svead.metrics import evaluate_scores, summarize                     # noqa: E402
from svead.svead_core import AGG_MEAN_SCORED, AGG_SUM_OVER_T, svead_score  # noqa: E402

M_GRID = [2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256]      # {2^1 .. 2^8}  (R7)
SEEDS = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]                        # 5 repeats    (R8)
T_ENSEMBLE = 100                               # fixed        (R7)
CONTRACT = os.path.join("state", "claim_contract.json")
RESULTS = "results"


def paper_targets():
    """Read the paper's reported values from the contract file (never hardcoded here)."""
    out = {}
    try:
        with open(CONTRACT, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            c = json.load(f)
        for cl in c["claims"]:
            out[cl["id"]] = {"value": cl.get("value"), "metric": cl.get("metric"),
                              "dataset": cl.get("dataset"), "statement": cl.get("statement"),
                              "reported_spread": cl.get("reported_spread")}
        out["_tolerance"] = c.get("tolerance", {})
        out["_match_target"] = c.get("match_target", {}).get("claim_id", "C1")
    except Exception as e:                                        # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"[repro] could not read contract targets: {e}")
    return out


def run_protocol(Xs, y, agg=AGG_MEAN_SCORED, verbose=True):
    """m-grid x 5 repeats, exactly the paper's protocol (R7, R8, R9, R10)."""
    runs = []
    for m in M_GRID:
        for seed in SEEDS:
            t0 = time.time()
            s, diag = svead_score(Xs, m=m, t=T_ENSEMBLE, seed=seed,
                                  agg=agg, return_diag=True)
            dt = time.time() - t0
            ev = evaluate_scores(s, y)                            # labels used only here
            rec = {"m": m, "seed": seed, "t": T_ENSEMBLE, "agg": agg,
                   "auc_roc": ev["auc_roc"], "auc_pr": ev["auc_pr"],
                   "auc_pr_trapezoid": ev["auc_pr_trapezoid"],
                   "seconds": dt,
                   "skipped_fraction": diag["skipped_fraction"],
                   "max_cell_size": diag["max_cell_size"],
                   "mean_cell_size": diag["mean_cell_size"],
                   "points_never_scored": diag["points_never_scored"]}
            runs.append(rec)
            if verbose:
                print(f"  m={m:4d} seed={seed}  AUC-ROC={ev['auc_roc']:.4f}  "
                      f"AUC-PR={ev['auc_pr']:.4f}  ({dt:.2f}s)")
    return runs


def per_m_summary(runs):
    out = {}
    for m in M_GRID:
        sel = [r for r in runs if r["m"] == m]
        out[str(m)] = {
            "auc_roc": summarize([r["auc_roc"] for r in sel]),
            "auc_pr": summarize([r["auc_pr"] for r in sel]),
            "auc_pr_trapezoid": summarize([r["auc_pr_trapezoid"] for r in sel]),
            "seconds_mean": float(np.mean([r["seconds"] for r in sel])),
            "skipped_fraction_mean": float(np.mean([r["skipped_fraction"] for r in sel])),
        }
    return out


def scalability_probe(m_selected, t=T_ENSEMBLE, n=500_000, d=10, seed=1):

    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    X = rng.normal(size=(n, d))
    res = {"n": n, "d": d, "t": t, "device": "CPU (this machine)",

        res[f"seconds_m{m}_full_pipeline"] = round(time.time() - t0, 3)

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="ignore any cached run and recompute")
    ap.add_argument("--no-scalability", action="store_true", help="skip the C5 timing probe")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    targets = paper_targets()

def score_partition(X, A, anchor_idx, cell_ids, delta, exclude_anchor_from_stats=False):
    """Eq. (2)-(3): s(x) = (delta / delta_max) * delta_mean  (R3, R4).

    delta_max / delta_mean are computed for the WHOLE cell in one pass before any
    point is scored (R4); the anchor itself is part of its cell at distance 0
    unless exclude_anchor_from_stats=True (sensitivity variant).
    Singleton cells (|C_i| = 1, only the anchor) get NaN -> skipped (R5).
    """
    counts = np.bincount(cell_ids, minlength=A.shape[0]).astype(np.float64)
    sums = np.bincount(cell_ids, weights=delta, minlength=A.shape[0]).astype(np.float64)
    delta_max = np.bincount(cell_ids, weights=delta, minlength=A.shape[0]).astype(np.float64)
    # np.bincount with weights does summation, so recompute max via a sort trick:
    # max per cell = delta of the last point of that cell in cell-sorted order
    order = np.argsort(cell_ids, kind="stable")
    sorted_cells = cell_ids[order]
    sorted_delta = delta[order]
    last = np.searchsorted(sorted_cells, np.arange(A.shape[0], dtype=np.int64), side="right") - 1
    has = counts > 0
    delta_max = np.where(has, sorted_delta[np.clip(last, 0, len(sorted_delta) - 1)], 0.0)

    denom = counts.copy()
    if exclude_anchor_from_stats:
        denom = np.maximum(counts - 1.0, 1.0)
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        delta_mean = sums / denom
    delta_mean = np.where(counts > 0, delta_mean, 0.0)

    dm = delta_max[cell_ids]
    dmean = delta_mean[cell_ids]
    scores = np.where(dm > 0, (delta / dm) * dmean, 0.0)
    singleton = counts[cell_ids] <= 1          # |C_i| = 1 -> skip (R5)
    scores = np.where(singleton, np.nan, scores)
    return scores, counts, delta_max, delta_mean
